BiblicalUsage: In the Old Testament, ʼĕyâlûwth is the word for power; by implication, protection. It appears in Psalms, and each time it carries that same plain sense.
TheologicalSignificance: For me, ʼĕyâlûwth means power; by implication, protection, nothing more and nothing less.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
